source_units.text: They said to him, “What shall we do to you, so that the sea may subside for us?” For the sea kept raising a greater surge.
source_units.display_text: They said to him, “What shall we do to you, so that the sea may subside for us?” For the sea kept raising a greater surge.

source_units.text: Jonah went out of the city and sat opposite the city. He made himself a shelter there and sat beneath it in the shade, until he could see what would happen to the city.
